text: The Racius company-registry page for Construções Carlos Pinho, Lda. (NIF 503369489, Zona Industrial da Farrapa, Chave, Arouca) records a Sociedade por Quotas with share capital of EUR 500,000; no parent company or fund is listed. The Arouca club announcement confirms the company was the shirt sponsor for more than a decade before bwin.
short: Construções Carlos Pinho, Lda. is a self-owned Arouca construction company (NIF 503369489, EUR 500,000 capital).
